name: VoronoiField - Variations
description: Eight seeds side by side, the envelope sheet. What it watches for is the sliver — the long thin shard between two sites that landed too close, which reads as a drawing mistake rather than as a boundary, and is the reason sites are placed on a jittered grid instead of at random. Each caption carries the two facts that are invisible in the geometry: how many sites were left unresolved, and whether a cell was actually opened. A deliberate feature that silently failed to apply looks exactly like one that was never asked for.
